title: Intuit and OpenAI join forces on new AI-powered experiences
summary_lines: OpenAI and Intuit have entered a $100M+ multi-year partnership to launch Intuit app experiences in ChatGPT and expand Intuit’s use of OpenAI’s frontier models to power personalized financial tools.
